test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A boat covers a distance of 72 km downstream in 6 hours, while it takes 12 hours to cover the same distance upstream. What is the speed of the boat?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance downstream = 72 km

Time downstream = 6 hours

Distance upstream = 72 km

Time upstream = 12 hours

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Speed of boat = (Speed downstream + Speed upstream) / 2

**Calculation:**

Speed downstream = 72 km / 6 hours

⇒ Speed downstream = 12 km/h

Speed upstream = 72 km / 12 hours

⇒ Speed upstream = 6 km/h

Speed of boat = (12 km/h + 6 km/h) / 2

⇒ Speed of boat = 18 km/h / 2

⇒ Speed of boat = 9 km/h

**The speed of the boat is 9 km/h.**
